snippet.title: Lost Castle 2 - Game Trailer - Convergence Showcase
snippet.description: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters! https//store.steampowered.com/app/2445690/Lost_Castle_2/
